# Ubiquiti UniFi 5G Backup (U5G) — PoE 5G RedCap Failover Modem

**Category:** Networking gear (LTE/5G backup modem)

**MSRP:** $99.00

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Networking Interface | (1) GbE RJ45 port; 5G RedCap and LTE |
| SIM | (1) Nano-SIM (4FF), (1) eSIM |
| PoE Interface | (1) PoE input |
| Power Method | PoE |
| 5G NR Category | 5G RedCap |

## Notable Features

- Reduced-capability (5G RedCap) modem — trades peak throughput for lower cost vs. the full 5G NR UniFi 5G Max
- PoE-powered; adopts through any UniFi PoE switch port (LAN-connected backup via GRE tunnel, not tied to a gateway WAN port)
- Automatic failover when the primary WAN connection drops
- Dual SIM support: physical Nano-SIM (4FF) plus eSIM, carrier-agnostic
- Optional prepaid eSIM data packs available directly from Ubiquiti (from $60/year for 10 GB, on T-Mobile in the US)
- Built-in 1.14" status display for at-a-glance signal/connection status
- Flexible mounting: desktop stand, wall mount, or window mount, all included
